title: Some pages mix two Census survey periods
text: ZIP and county comparison pages show live American Community Survey 5-year estimates for 2020-2024 next to stored state benchmarks from 2018-2022. Compare figures only when their stated periods match.

title: Stored Census tables await the 2020-2024 release
text: County broadband (table B28002) and dual-eligible exposure (table B27010) use the 2019-2023 5-year release. Cross-domain indicators and ZIP quick stats use 2018-2022. Each figure is labeled with its own period until it is refreshed.

title: A few source lines name a year without the survey product
text: Some labels read "Census ACS 2022" or "Census ACS 2023" without saying 1-year or 5-year. Treat those figures as unconfirmed for period until the label is corrected.

title: Reuse terms are not yet recorded for any feed
text: Every catalog entry has licenseReviewStatus "pending" and a null license. A null license means unknown, not open. Two entries also carry attributionUnverified: true until their publisher is confirmed.

title: Use accessmi.org as the canonical copy
text: Copies of this project hosted on other platforms can lag behind or be unavailable. Cite and fetch from accessmi.org. Check /.well-known/build.json for the commit that is live.

title: Some live lookups run outside this site's build
text: Several proxy functions, including the Census ACS proxy, deploy separately from the website. The build manifest does not record their version. Treat their responses as live upstream reads and keep the notes field each response returns.

title: No query API or change feed yet
text: AccessMI publishes static JSON files and HTML pages. There is no filtered query endpoint and no notification when a file changes. Compare the catalog's _meta.generated date between reads to detect a rebuild.
